snippet.title: SORE CRATEBREAKER - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
You need to make $1,000,000. 
All you have is a hammer and a pile of crates.

SORE CRATEBREAKER is a first-person incremental horror game. Smash crates for whatever's inside, buy machines that smash for you, and try not to look into darkness too much.

Wishlist on Steam!

Made by Can of Worms.
Press and business: can_of_worms_games@proton.me

#indiegame #horrorgame #incremental
